rows.name: SKULMARTIN ROCK LIGHTVESSEL
rows.description: In 20 fms., about 1¼ mile E.S.E. of rock, and 8¼ miles N. ¾ E. from South Rock lt.-vessel. Two masts, with two half-globes on main-mast head......

rows.name: Donaghadee
rows.character: One fixed red or br. lt.
rows.description: White lt.-ho., 53 ft. high, on S.E. pier-head. Light red to seaward, from S.S.E. to N.E.; bright lt. obscured betw. S. ½ E. and shore

rows.name: MEW ISLAND
rows.description: Gray lt.-ho. on E. point. A group of 4 flashes in quick succession in every min., occupying about 22 secs. Obscured by Copeland Ids. Weak reflected flashes may be observed in the interval. Lt.-ho. is 4 cables East of Copeland lt.-ho., the latter light being discontinued...

rows.name: Belfast Bay
rows.character: 1. One occulting bright light, 12 secs. 2. Fixed lights
rows.description: 1. Pile lighthouse, in 8 ft. water, on elbow of Holywood Bank; light visible 8 secs., followed by three eclipses 2. Green light on Holywood Bank; two more green lights towards Belfast; and a red light S.W. of Stone Beacon

rows.name: Carrickfergus Harbour
rows.description: Fix. br. lt., 2h. before to 2h. after high water

rows.name: Larne Lough
rows.character: 1. One fix. br. or red lt. 2. Two fixed red lights
rows.description: 1. White lt.-ho., 50 ft. high, on Farres Point. Red sector over reef off Barr Point & Hunter Rock, between N.E. by E. & N.E. by E. ¾ E. Obscured East of latter bearing by land...... 2. On Curran pier, in line S.W. ¾ S. Low lt. obscured W. of N.E. ¾ N.

rows.name: MAIDENS
rows.description: Towers, 76 & 68 ft. high, white, with red belt. In one, N.W. by W. ¼ W., 800 yds. apart ...

rows.name: RATHLIN
rows.character: One intermittent bright or red light, and one fixed bright light
rows.description: White tower, 88 feet high, with red belt, on Altacarry or N.E. point. Upper light intermittent, bright 50 secs., eclipsed 10 secs. Shown to N. and E., from N.W. to S.W. by S., and in Rathlin Sound from S.W. by W. ¼ W. to W. ½ S. Red light over Carrickvanan Rock. Lower fixed light visible seaward between N.W. by N. and S.W. by S. ½ S., but does not show in Rathlin Sound ......

rows.name: Port Rush
rows.description: On N.W. pier. A red sector to S.W. from South pier......

rows.name: Coleraine
rows.description: Red lt. on S.W. pier; and green lts. lead in...

rows.name: Inishowen
rows.description: East tower, 49 ft.; West tower, 74 ft. On Dunagree Point. In one, West, 153 yards apart. A red sector from West tower, 25 ft. below bright light, over Tuns Bank, from E. by S. ¾ S. to S.E. ¾ E.

rows.name: Warren Point
rows.character: One fix. red or br. lt.
rows.description: Red to South betw. W. by S. ¼ S. and E. ¼ N.; thence bright seaward to the land, and up Lough Foyle from W. by S. ¼ S. to W. ½ S.

rows.name: Moville
rows.description: Pile lt.-ho. in 9 ft. water, nearly 3 cables S.S.E. from the quay. Visible 5 secs., eclipsed 5 secs.

rows.name: Red Castle
rows.description: Bright lt. on red piles, outer edge of Ridge Shoal

rows.name: White Castle
rows.description: Bright lt. on black piles, S.E. side of channel

rows.name: Ture
rows.description: Bright lt. on black piles, S.E. side of channel

rows.name: Cunnyberry
rows.description: Bright lt. on red piles, N.W. side of channel

rows.name: Culmore Point
rows.description: Bright lantern light on a red mast ............

rows.name: Culkeeragh
rows.description: One fixed bright light, East side of entrance

rows.name: Boom Hall
rows.description: One fixed bright light, N.W. side of channel

rows.name: Rosse Bay
rows.description: One fix. bright lt., on piles, S. side of channel

rows.name: Rock Mill
rows.description: Leading lts. for channel in Rosse Bay; br. gas lt. near Rock Mill dock, and a red lt. from wooden house on Talis wall, 200 yds. to E. by S.

rows.name: INNISTRAHULL
rows.character: One rev. br. lt., ½ min.
rows.description: White tower, 42 feet high, on N.E. part of island......

rows.name: Dunree Head
rows.description: Shown from a dwelling-house, visible between N.E. by N. ½ N. and S. ½ E. ........

rows.name: Buncrana Pier
rows.description: From pillar on pier extremity, betw. N. by W. ½ W. and W. by S. ¼ S.; guide to anchorage

rows.name: FANNET POINT
rows.character: 1. One occult. bright or red light, ½ min. 2. One fixed bright lt.
rows.description: 1. White tower, 26 feet high. Light is visible 5 secs., eclipsed 2½ secs., visible 20 secs., and eclipsed 2½ secs. Bright seaward to S. by E., and thence red to the land...... 2. At 55 feet below main light; shown over Limeburner Rock, between N. 44° W. and N. 54° W. ......

rows.name: TORY ISLAND
rows.description: White tower, 87 ft. high, on the N.W. point. Obscured by island between S.E. by E. ¼ E. and S.E. ¾ S. ......
